title: The agent wakes when the generations drain, and one ask can fan out over many cards
description: A finished generation is silent until the user types: settle() pushes the note into _notes and nothing runs a turn. Fabio hit it live twice on 2026-09-21. Wake an IDLE conversation when _inflight drains, through agentSessions.queue. The RENDERER owns the wake, because the connector generate route has no project targeting and only the renderer knows which project is open. Second half: generate takes a cards list so one ask fans out over many, with a yes/no confirm card above 5 cards (Fabio, 2026-09-21). Seven design rules and the open questions are in MPI-817 plan.md, section Phase C, first piece.
